description: This file contains a mock class UdevImplMock used for testing, which mocks the interface UdevImpl related to udev device management, utilizing Google Mock framework.

classes.name: UdevImplMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of UdevImpl for unit testing udev device interactions, providing mocked methods for creating and managing udev devices and enumerations.

methods.name: udev_enumerate_new
methods.description: Creates a new udev enumeration object.

methods.name: udev_enumerate_add_match_subsystem
methods.description: Adds a match rule for subsystem to the enumeration.

methods.name: udev_enumerate_get_list_entry
methods.description: Gets the list of entries from enumeration.

methods.name: udev_list_entry_get_name
methods.description: Gets the name of a list entry.

methods.name: udev_device_new_from_syspath
methods.description: Creates a udev device object from a sysfs path.

methods.name: udev_device_get_parent_with_subsystem_devtype
methods.description: Retrieves parent device with specific subsystem and devtype.

methods.name: udev_device_get_devtype
methods.description: Gets the device type of a udev device.

methods.name: udev_device_get_devnode
methods.description: Returns the device node path of a udev device.
